data.title: SES and Elveo Mobile Deepen Collaboration to Advance Direct-to-Device Services in Europe
data.description: Luxembourg and Washington - SES, a prominent space solutions provider, and Elveo Mobile, a company focusing on mobile connectivity and advanced intelligence, have revealed an enhanced partnership to expedite the rollout of direct-to-device (D2D) services across Europe. The collaboration involves SES utilizing Elveo's efficient and established D2D technology to facilitate smooth mobile roaming services for consumers, businesses, governments, and institutions in Europe. This strategic move aims to improve connectivity and enable easier access to D2D services for a wide range of users in the European market.

data.title: Increase of share capital in connection with the share option programme and subscription results
data.description: The Board of AS Tallink Grupp has decided to boost the Group's share capital by EUR 2,451,661 by issuing new ordinary shares. This decision was made in relation to the utilization of options granted under the share option scheme endorsed by the Group's General Meeting of Shareholders on June 13, 2023. The increase in share capital aligns with the stipulations outlined in the share option programme.

data.title: Echion Technologies signs MOU with Korean total battery solutions provider Energy Tech Solution to grow the XNO® battery manufacturing ecosystem
data.description: An international partnership is set to expedite the integration of XNO® into the advanced battery sector to assist high-intensity industrial clients. The collaboration between Echion Technologies and Energy Tech Solution was unveiled on September 15, 2026 in London. Through a memorandum of understanding (MoU), the two companies aim to leverage their expertise to propel XNO®'s presence in the market and cater to the needs of industrial users requiring robust energy solutions. This strategic alliance is anticipated to significantly enhance XNO®'s position and boost its offerings in the advanced battery industry.
